title: the SQL-from-strings rules run over the tree (plan 10 row 10G-42 (b))
note: New findings of the fifteen rules of tools/sql_rules.py over services/, libs/ and deploy/ on master f6c42230: the hits that no earlier finding covers. Hits on places that H10G42 already holds (10G-42 (c)) are counted under those ids in tools/sql_rules_ledger.yaml, not repeated here. basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code (and, for H10G42B-01, a synthetic DuckDB run), not an attack on a box. lane is the lane that owns the file; the integrator sends the fixes to lane J.

findings.claim: operator environment values reach DuckDB SET text unescaped in LakeStore._harden (services/lake/store.py:1641-1643): TB_LAKE_MEMORY_LIMIT, TB_LAKE_TEMP_DIR (or TB_LAKE_DIR) and TB_LAKE_MAX_TEMP are written inside single quotes, so a value with a quote ends the literal and runs further statements before enable_external_access and lock_configuration are set (1645-1646)
findings.path: deploy/.env or the container environment -> memory_limit() (store.py:703), temp_dir() (store.py:743), temp_limit() (store.py:731) -> con.execute(f"SET ... = '{value}'") at 1641-1643
findings.validation: none in code; DuckDB's execute runs every statement of a text (shown on duckdb 1.5.5 with a synthetic value: a quote, then CREATE TABLE, ran)
findings.expected: values bound as parameters (DuckDB SET accepts a prepared value through set_config or a checked literal), or identifiers quoted with psycopg.sql.Identifier; the fix goes to lane J (the integrator's narrowing of 2026-11-18)

findings.claim: the same operator environment values reach DuckDB SET text unescaped in the lake build (LakeStore._build, services/lake/store.py:1434-1435): TB_LAKE_MEMORY_LIMIT and the spill directory (TB_LAKE_TEMP_DIR or TB_LAKE_DIR) inside single quotes
findings.path: deploy/.env or the container environment -> memory_limit(), temp_dir() -> con.execute(f"SET ... = '{value}'") at 1434-1435
findings.validation: none in code; the actor is whoever sets the service's environment, who can already change the box
findings.expected: values bound as parameters (DuckDB SET accepts a prepared value through set_config or a checked literal), or identifiers quoted with psycopg.sql.Identifier; the fix goes to lane J (the integrator's narrowing of 2026-11-18)

OWNER TO inside hand-made double quotes without doubling embedded quotes, as the box's admin; a restored dump that carries a relation whose name holds a double quote would end the identifier
findings.path: a restore (database content) -> pg_class.relname of objects in the schema owned by session_user (db.py:493-498) -> tx.execute(f'ALTER {kind} "{schema}"."{name}" OWNER TO "{owner}"')
findings.validation: the schema and owner are checked names (_SCHEMA_RE and fixed prefixes); relname is not checked; not run against a crafted dump
findings.expected: values bound as parameters (DuckDB SET accepts a prepared value through set_config or a checked literal), or identifiers quoted with psycopg.sql.Identifier; the fix goes to lane J (the integrator's narrowing of 2026-11-18)
